title: fix: hotplug event queue drops events silently on overflow
description:
In wp11_pkcs11.c, when the hotplug event queue (size WP11_HOTPLUG_QUEUE_SIZE=16) is full, new events are silently dropped. The comment at the drop site acknowledges this. C_WaitForSlotEvent callers have no mechanism to detect that an event was dropped.

Impact: In rapid-plug/unplug scenarios (or test scenarios that inject many synthetic events), a token insertion may be dropped and never signaled to the waiting application. The application believes the slot is still empty.

Fix: Options in order of preference:
1. Increase WP11_HOTPLUG_QUEUE_SIZE to 64 (probably sufficient).
2. Set a 'queue overflow' flag that causes the next C_WaitForSlotEvent to return a synthetic CKR_DEVICE_ERROR.
3. Replace the fixed queue with a growable ring buffer.
At minimum, add a counter for dropped events that can be queried for diagnostics.
